sources.title: Presidency of the Republic of Ghana

capital.evidence_quote: Accra is the constitutional capital, economic engine, and coastal metropolis of Ghana

currency.evidence_quote: The Ghana Cedi (GHS, GH₵) is the official national currency issued and managed by Bank of Ghana

timezone.evidence_quote: Ghana strictly operates on Greenwich Mean Time (UTC+0) year-round without daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic electrical supply across Ghana is nominal 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national transmission grid frequency is maintained stably at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: British Type G three-pin plugs are universal in modern installations, with Type D round sockets in older buildings

police.evidence_quote: Dial 191 (or 18555 toll-free) nationwide for rapid response from the Ghana Police Service

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 193 for National Ambulance Service medical evacuation and emergency paramedic care

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 192 for Ghana National Fire Service emergency firefighting and rescue teams

general.evidence_quote: Dial 112 nationwide from any phone network for unified emergency response dispatch

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.ru: Стандартные меры предосторожности (Одно из самых безопасных и стабильных направлений Западной Африки)

regional_warnings.area: Northern border towns in Upper East and Upper West regions
regional_warnings.reason: Border proximity caution due to regional security dynamics in neighboring Burkina Faso

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Ghana registers median mobile cellular download speeds around 26.8 Mbps on MTN and Telecel 4G

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Urban fixed broadband in Accra and Kumasi averages median download speeds of 36.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM registration mandates biometric registration with passport ID; MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) is ubiquitous across street stalls and taxis
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM re-registration regulations require verified passport identification under NCA mandates

religion.evidence_quote: Ghana Census records approximately 71 percent Christian and 20 percent Muslim population living peacefully

festivals.value: Chale Wote Street Art Festival (James Town, Aug), Homowo (Ga festival), Aboakyer, Hogbetsotso, AfroFuture (Dec)

sources.title: Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture Ghana

festivals.evidence_quote: Chale Wote and December in GH festivals attract hundreds of thousands of international visitors to Accra

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Always use the right hand to give or receive items, greet elders first; modest swimwear appropriate on resort beaches only; LGBTQ+ travelers should exercise high discretion due to conservative social laws; drugs heavily penalized
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Respect for cultural etiquette and right-hand customary use are fundamental social values in Ghana

tipping.value: Customary in hospitality; 5-10% in sit-down restaurants in Accra; small tips for drivers, tour guides, and hotel staff warmly received
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is welcomed and common in tourist hotels, restaurants, and historical heritage sites
